page.overview:
Who is Borsody family?

Borsody (Borsodi in the original Sapkowski novels) is the surname of an elite Redanian family.

In , they were just simple merchants with horses and sheep, but by the mid- they had managed to rise so much that the Borsody Auction House became the largest and most reputable in the Northern Realms, located on Novigrad's main square in an impressive three-story building.

Later on, during the s, when King Radovid V offered them zero percent taxation policy, they relocated to Oxenfurt.
